title: Build a min-max stack in Rust with O(1) get_min and get_max
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement MinMaxStack<T> that supports push, pop, peek, get_min, and get_max all in O(1) using auxiliary min/max tracking stacks.

required_artifacts: Three Vec fields: data, min_stk, max_stk
push maintains min_stk and max_stk invariants
pop removes from min_stk/max_stk when the popped value equals their top
get_min and get_max are O(1) via stack tops
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
